definitions.explanation: An animal that has no backbone, such as an insect, mollusk, or worm. Contrasts with {脊椎動物|せきついどうぶつ} (vertebrate).

examples.japanese: {昆虫|こんちゅう}は{無脊椎動物|むせきついどうぶつ}だ。
{海|うみ}には{多|おお}くの{無脊椎動物|むせきついどうぶつ}が{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: Many invertebrates live in the sea.

examples.japanese: {地球上|ちきゅうじょう}の{動物|どうぶつ}の{大部分|だいぶぶん}は{無脊椎動物|むせきついどうぶつ}である。
examples.english: The great majority of animals on Earth are invertebrates.

notes:
Formed from {無|む} (without) + {脊椎|せきつい} (spine) + {動物|どうぶつ} (animal). A biology term.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脊椎動物|せきついどうぶつ}: vertebrate — the antonym, animals with a backbone
- {昆虫|こんちゅう}: insect — a familiar subgroup of invertebrates
